pages: Manaia, a Maori girl of twelve with long black hair in a single plait, in a bright yellow rain jacket, dark blue trousers and gumboots, stands on a round concrete pier beside one green steel lock gate, one hand on its rail. Middle distance: a handwheel on the harbour wall, a mooring bollard. Background: the still basin, low morning sun.

Manaia, a Maori girl of twelve with long black hair in a single plait, in a bright yellow rain jacket, dark blue trousers and gumboots, leans over the white gauge post in the basin and reads the dark painted bands up its side. Middle distance: the green steel gate, a folded tide table. Background: sea wall, flat morning light.

Manaia, a Maori girl of twelve with long black hair in a single plait, in a bright yellow rain jacket, dark blue trousers and gumboots, walks the sea wall and puts one hand on the second gauge standing at the water's edge. Middle distance: a screwed-down tide table, a coiled rope. Background: the harbour, bright morning sun.

On the pontoon, Manaia, a Maori girl of twelve with long black hair in a single plait, in a bright yellow rain jacket, dark blue trousers and gumboots, grips the big iron wheel and winds it, the basin rising behind her. Middle distance: a green steel gate, a mooring bollard. Background: harbour wall and hills, bright tide daylight.

Manaia, a Maori girl of twelve with long black hair in a single plait, in a bright yellow rain jacket, dark blue trousers and gumboots, stands at the white gauge post and lays one finger against a dark painted band. Middle distance: an open book, a pencil. Background: the green steel gate and sea wall, morning light.

Manaia, a Maori girl of twelve with long black hair in a single plait, in a bright yellow rain jacket, dark blue trousers and gumboots, stands on the round concrete pier as the green steel gate swings hard against its stop. Middle distance: a mooring bollard, the pontoon. Background: the basin, choppy water. Overcast afternoon light.

At dusk Manaia, a Maori girl of twelve with long black hair in a single plait, in a bright yellow rain jacket, dark blue trousers and gumboots, kneels by the white gauge post and reads the wet line on it again. Middle distance: a torch, the lock gate. Background: the darkening basin, harbour lamps coming on.

Manaia, a Maori girl of twelve with long black hair in a single plait, in a bright yellow rain jacket, dark blue trousers and gumboots, sets one straight stick with a nail in its end floating on the still basin water and holds it. Middle distance: a scrap of paper, the shut sluice. Background: green steel gate, grey morning light.

Manaia, a Maori girl of twelve with long black hair in a single plait, in a bright yellow rain jacket, dark blue trousers and gumboots, crouches at the water and holds the nail-ended stick upright to read the drop. Middle distance: an open book, a scrap of paper. Background: the basin wall, flat overcast daylight.

On the pontoon, Manaia, a Maori girl of twelve with long black hair in a single plait, in a bright yellow rain jacket, dark blue trousers and gumboots, holds the nail-ended stick flat above the water for another pair of eyes. Middle distance: the open book, the green steel gate. Background: the harbour, cool Wednesday light.

At high water, Manaia, a Maori girl of twelve with long black hair in a single plait, in a bright yellow rain jacket, dark blue trousers and gumboots, leans into the open logbook and writes the finishing time. Middle distance: a pencil, the shut sluice wheel. Background: the round pier and the swung gate, bright afternoon sun.
